a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value the frozen construction roster docs/receipts/rosters/a2t-evo-fold-a-v2.json carries as its own split_identity_hash. Both cover the same 424 rows.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.

a2t_calibration_sentinel_rows: A SENTINEL row's gold tool is one the corpus cannot supply enough rows of to reward on. It is flown like any other row and it is never a reward row: rails.evolution_carrier.rows_of_target_from_roster removes it from stage one's slice, it falls to the confirmation's background bound, and any harm on it is named in the round receipt's sentinel_harms line. The tools are declared in configs/knowledge/a2t-evo-a1/loop-v1.json.
a2t_calibration_tier7_media_binding: tier7_multiturn rows bind the FIRST user turn -- audio_paths[0] of the released Tier7Dataset._get_audio_paths, the same binding the three sealed official-population rosters and the 4,000 final read use. data.audio2tool._entry_media reads chat_history[-1] instead (the P1 scaffold's final-turn binding), and on all 92 tier-7 rows of the two folds the two differ, so the choice is recorded rather than inherited: a fold's selection signal is measured on the same utterance the population the loop must transfer to is measured on.
